_source: NOTES.md, creature strains. LIVE TABLE (L27b): Bestiary loads this at _static_init; the const table in bestiary.gd is only the fallback when this file is missing or broken.
_format: tint/glow are [r,g,b] 0-1. hp/atk/spd multiply the creature's stats, scale multiplies its height. particle: ember rises, drip falls, wisp drifts, spark flickers, spore hangs slow. wild: the glow wanders the hue wheel (monster.gd _tick_wild).
_measured: Strains IMPROVED survival (83% vs 63%) and soul retention. Do not soften them.
_gating: Floors 1-2 are 85% plain so a new hero meets something readable; depth 10+ is only 15% plain.
